xiake.label: 侠客
xiake.prompt_en: Ancient Chinese wandering-hero storytelling, an expressive individual hero, readable martial posture, grounded weight and cloth movement, sculptural fabric and worn travel equipment.

jianghu.label: 江湖
jianghu.prompt_en: Ancient Chinese jianghu worldbuilding, lived-in inns and travel routes, legible social relationships, layered miniature set dressing with clear foreground, middle ground and background.

zhiguai.label: 志怪
zhiguai.prompt_en: Ancient Chinese zhiguai folklore fantasy, a quiet uncanny anomaly inside an otherwise tangible world, restrained supernatural presence, mist and motivated paper-lantern glow, emotionally readable suspense.
avoid: particle storms hiding the uncanny detail

historical.label: 历史人物
historical.focus: 有明确时期背景的人物与事件
historical.prompt_en: Historical Chinese character storytelling within a stylized animated world, restrained characterization, period context guided by the supplied brief, tangible sculptural garments and tools.
avoid: unsupported claims of exact historical reconstruction

mythology.label: 神话
mythology.prompt_en: Chinese mythological storytelling, clear monumental scale contrasts, expressive deity or mythical-creature silhouettes, sculptural cloud and mountain forms, controlled otherworldly light while preserving handcrafted miniature materials.
